item.title: Claude Code
item.description: It’s been about a year since I last tried to “vibe code” and I used the normal Claude LLM to do so. The experience was okay, but frustrating. When using the standard chat interface, you have to be very specific about what you’re feeding the chat and make sure that you keep the context window fairly short, because eventually the tool will start hallucinating more and more as you go on.
